Milestone 2 Completion Report: Initial Smart Contract Development and Google Forms Add-on Build
Deliverables Overview
1. Functional Smart Contract Deployed on Cardano Test Network
Links:
・Deployment on Preview Network: https://preview.cardanoscan.io/address/70115a9d203f2a323ead5a6328181773faccc8473f859a19fb5a028715
・Integrated DApp:
・Live Application: https://adaverc.vercel.app/
・Source Code: https://github.com/adaverc/adaverc-dapp

Technical Implementation Coverage:
The deployed smart contract (adaverc_registry) implements a validation system specifically designed for blockchain-based form response verification:
・Smart Contract Validation: The contract validates transactions containing Adaverc metadata using label 8434, ensuring only properly formatted hash submissions are accepted
・UTxO Management: Each hash storage operation creates a new contract UTxO with ~2 ADA, providing decentralized storage while maintaining transaction integrity
・Metadata Schema: Structured metadata storage includes hash value, form ID, response ID, timestamp, and version information for comprehensive verification tracking
・Cost Optimization: Transaction fees optimized at ~2.175 ADA per hash (0.175 ADA network fee + 2 ADA UTxO), with future optimization pathways identified
・Blockfrost Integration: Read-only verification queries through Blockfrost API enable free hash verification without additional transaction costs

ms.report:
Milestone 3 Completion Report
Project Context
NOTAMPERDATA is an Anti Research Fraud dApp designed to address research fraud, specifically data tampering in primary data collected from research subjects. Initially focused on Qualtrics, the project through a change of scope request was approved for change to create an add-on for Google Forms while maintaining the same vision of ensuring data integrity and immutability.
With an aim of building a more comprehensive platform that features other platforms popular with researchers and research communities, we settled on the name NOTAMPERDATA. Our project website is deployed at https://www.notamperdata.com/ and our add-on is currently under Google's review, which is a requirement for the next milestone.
Add-on Source Code: https://github.com/notamperdata/notamperdata-addon

Milestone Outputs Delivered
1. Enhanced Blockchain Integration with Verification Features
Status: ✅ Completed
In the previous milestone, we developed a basic smart contract. After technical analysis of the solution and the project needs, we decided to proceed with Cardano's native metadata feature. This approach ensures data integrity and immutability for Google Forms submissions while being more cost-effective and faster than Datum implementation. The rationale for this technical choice is documented in the smart contract repository and the hash storage implementation on the dapp’s source code.
Dapp source code: https://github.com/notamperdata/notamperdata-dapp 
Smart contract repository: https://github.com/notamperdata/notamperdata-sc 
2. Test Cases and Preliminary Results
Status: ✅ Completed
Comprehensive test cases have been developed and executed, demonstrating successful functionality across various scenarios.
Link to Testing Documentation: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1sd7cJ0C2PZ3mItir2yr7EpGjQ7E9jv7zs02ZUjCHAKM/edit?usp=sharing 
3. Add-on User Guide and Source Code Documentation
Status: ✅ Completed
Complete documentation has been prepared

ms.report:
Milestone 4 Completion/ Closeout Report
Project Context
NoTamperData is an anti-research fraud solution that prevents data tampering in primary research data collected via Google Forms. The platform leverages Cardano blockchain's native metadata feature to ensure data integrity and immutability. This milestone represents the final phase of the project, transitioning from development to mainnet deployment and community engagement.
Project Website: https://www.notamperdata.com/
Milestone Outputs Delivered
1. Live Google Forms Add-on Connected to Cardano Mainnet
Status: ✅ Completed
The NoTamperData platform has been successfully deployed and is operational on the Cardano mainnet. The add-on enables researchers to automatically hash and store Google Forms responses on-chain for verification and tamper-proof data integrity.
List of Mainnet Test Transactions: https://github.com/notamperdata/notamperdata-addon/blob/main/Tests/TESTS.md 
2. Test Reports
Status: ✅ Completed
